fields.name: TransactionalId
fields.about: The transactional ID, or null if the producer is not transactional.

fields.name: Acks
fields.about: The number of acknowledgments the producer requires the leader to have received before considering a request complete. Allowed values: 0 for no acknowledgments, 1 for only the leader and -1 for the full ISR.

fields.name: TimeoutMs
fields.about: The timeout to await a response in milliseconds.

fields.name: Records
fields.about: The record data to be produced.
